C1.title: Control Environment, Governance & Segregation of Duties (SoD)
C1.controls: Separate Authorization, Custody, and Recordkeeping/Reconciliation; Owner holds primary admin & reviews monthly bank statements/check images directly from bank portal ($\$0$).
C1.citations: Single-person full transaction chain present in $> 85\%$ of prosecuted SMB embezzlements ($n = 340$).

C2.title: Entity-Level Legal & Headcount Threshold Inventory
C2.controls: Annual 1-page headcount & nexus legal inventory with CPA/broker ($\$0$, $2\text{h}$); dual-custodian alerts $60\text{d}/30\text{d}$ pre-renewal.
C2.citations: Crossing $5$ (TN Workers' Comp), $15$ (Title VII/ADA/PWFA), $20$ (ADEA/COBRA), $35$ (TN E-Verify), or $50$ (FMLA/ACA) staff unnoticed.

C3.title: Revenue, Cash Receipts & Receivables (incl. Mailbox)
C3.controls: ACH/lockbox/UPIC; restrictive endorsement at mail opening; automated monthly customer statements; independent monthly review of AR aging, credit memos & write-offs; numbered dispatch tickets; supervisor PIN on POS voids/refunds.
C3.citations: Skimming ($19\%$ of SMB cases, $18\text{-mo}$ median lag), cash larceny ($17\%$), AR lapping, fake write-offs. UCC § 3-206; AU-C 265.

C4.title: Purchasing, Accounts Payable & Vendor Master File
C4.controls: Mandatory out-of-band phone callback to pre-existing number on file before any bank routing change; ban email-only wire/ACH instructions; separate vendor master creation from bill pay & TIN vetting; 3-way match ($0.0\%$ unit-price variance).
C4.citations: BEC vendor impersonation ($63\%$ of BEC per AFP; $\$2.77\text{B}$–$\$3.0\text{B}$ FBI IC3 annual losses); shell LLC billing ($31\%$ of SMB fraud); kickbacks ($45\%$).

C5.title: Cash Disbursements, Checks, Wires & Treasury Banking
C5.controls: 6-account treasury split; **Payee Positive Pay (`default = RETURN`)**; **ACH Debit Blocks/Filters** by 10-char Originator ID; ban rubber signature stamps; dual release across all channels; disable Zelle/RDC for outsiders.
C5.citations: Checks $= 36\%$ of prosecuted insider thefts; $680\text{k}+$ FinCEN check-washing SARs; UCC § 4-406 ($30\text{d}/1\text{yr}$ bar); UCC § 4A-202; Nacha R29 ($2\text{-day}$ corporate ACH return cliff; no Reg E on business accounts).

C6.title: Payroll & HR Administration
C6.controls: Pre-transmission owner review of Payroll Change Exception Register; employee callback on direct-deposit bank changes; quarterly owner EFTPS check; deposit 401(k)/SIMPLE deferrals $\le 7$ business days; written IRC § 125 POP plan.
C6.citations: Ghost employees & salary padding ($14\%$ of SMB cases); non-CPEO payroll processor theft; 29 C.F.R. § 2510.3-102; IRC § 125(d); IRC § 3511.

C7.title: Tax Collection, Filing & Trust-Fund Remittance
C7.controls: Dedicated Trust-Fund Tax Bank Account; direct owner EFTPS enrollment; monthly POS sales tax vs. DOR remittance tie-out; W-9 before first vendor payment; Form 8300 $\le 15\text{d}$ on cash $> \$10,000$.
C7.citations: Borrowing payroll/sales tax during cash crunch = *per se* willful personal liability under IRC § 6672 & T.C.A. § 67-1-1443; IRC § 6721 ($\$25\text{k}$ Form 8300 penalty).

C8.title: Company Cards, Expense Reimbursements & Cash Advances
C8.controls: Per-card dollar caps & MCC blocks; zero cards for outside CPAs/bookkeepers; itemized receipt (not summary slip) required under written Accountable Plan; $120.0\text{-hour}$ cash advance settlement lock.
C8.citations: Personal Amazon/travel/gift-card spend on corporate cards; taxable wage reclassification under 26 C.F.R. § 1.62-2; Hawkeye receipt fraud.

C9.title: Inventory, Fleet, Tools, Equipment & Controlled Assets
C9.controls: Perpetual tracking + surprise cycle counts by staff who do not adjust stock records; GPS/fuel-card PIN matching; dual-witness controlled-substance logs in clinical settings.
C9.citations: Shrinkage, scrap/copper theft, phantom inventory write-offs, surgical implant/DEA diversion.

C10.title: Financial Close, Reconciliations & General Ledger
C10.controls: Independent monthly bank/card/tax/loan reconciliation $\le 20$–$30\text{d}$ post-close using raw bank portal PDFs; Owner-only QuickBooks/Xero closing-date password; review manual JEs & balance-sheet suspense/accrual accounts.
C10.citations: Hiding thefts via fake COGS/Supplies JEs (*US v. Means*, *US v. Austin*), prior-period edits, or accrual parking (*Macy's* $\$151\text{M}$ trap).

C11.title: IT Access, MFA, SaaS Custody & Tested Backups
C11.controls: Mandatory phishing-resistant MFA on email, bank, payroll & ERP; named logins in enterprise vault; $1.0\text{-hour}$ offboarding revocation checklist; 3-2-1 backups with $\ge 1$ immutable/offline copy test-restored semi-annually.
C11.citations: Ransomware in $88\%$ of SMB breaches (Verizon DBIR); ITGC weaknesses in $55\%$ of material weaknesses (KPMG); active ex-employee logins (*US v. Willard*).

C12.title: Privacy, Encryption & Data-Protection Compliance
C12.controls: FIPS 140-2 full-disk encryption (BitLocker/FileVault); FTC Safeguards WISP (16 C.F.R. Part 314); HIPAA SRA & BAAs; tokenized PCI SAQ-A payments; 45-day TN breach workflow; strip Meta Pixels from clinical forms.
C12.citations: T.C.A. § 47-18-2107 (45-day breach clock & FIPS 140-2 safe harbor); TIPA (T.C.A. § 47-18-3301); PIPEDA; Quebec Law 25.

C13.title: Employment, Wage-Hour, I-9/E-Verify & Workplace Safety
C13.controls: I-9 within $3$ business days + E-Verify ($35+$ FTE in TN); timekeeping meal-break attestations; FLSA overtime true-up on non-discretionary bonuses; OSHA logs/programs; 5-guardrail handbook audit.
C13.citations: 8 C.F.R. § 274a.10; T.C.A. § 50-1-703; T.C.A. § 50-6-405 ($1.5\times$–$3\times$ premium penalty); 29 C.F.R. § 578.3 ($\$2,515$ FLSA willful penalty); OSHA ($\$16,550$ serious / $\$165,514$ willful; up to $70\%$ $\le 25$-staff reduction); Ontario OHSA § 32.0.1.

C14.title: Contracts, Licenses, Insurance & Underwriting Warranties
C14.controls: Dual-custodian renewal cliff tracker; Crime policy with explicit **Social Engineering Endorsement**; pre-binding audit ensuring every control checked "Yes" on ACORD/Cyber/Crime apps runs with logs; claim $-15\%$ to $-25\%$ Schedule Rating Credits.
C14.citations: Policy rescission (*Pioneer Industries v. Hartford*); Computer Fraud BEC circuit split (*Medidata* [2d Cir.] & *American Tooling* [6th Cir.] vs. *Apache* [5th Cir.]).

C15.title: Records Retention & Litigation Hold
C15.controls: 1-page Retention Schedule (Payroll $4\text{ yrs}$; Tax $7\text{ yrs}$; I-9 longer of $3\text{ yrs}$ post-hire or $1\text{ yr}$ post-term; ERISA permanent) + immediate Litigation Hold SOP freezing auto-deletion upon dispute/charge + annual PII purge.
C15.citations: Fed. R. Civ. P. 37(e) ESI spoliation sanctions; 29 C.F.R. § 516.5; 8 C.F.R. § 274a.2.

C16.title: Business Continuity & Key-Person Risk
C16.controls: Enterprise password vault with Owner break-glass custody; $\ge 2$ bank signers; 1-page payroll/AP runbooks; **mandatory $5$-consecutive-business-day ($40.0\text{-hour}$) annual vacation** with cross-coverage for anyone handling money.
C16.citations: Key-person lockout on EFTPS/bank/DNS; mandatory vacation/rotation cuts median fraud loss by $49\%$ (ACFE RTTN; $18\%$ of fraudsters refuse vacation/sharing).

C17.title: Fraud Detection, Whistleblower Tips & Surprise Monitoring
C17.controls: Web-form / dedicated email tip channel routed directly to Owner/outside CPA (bypassing office/finance mgrs) + anti-retaliation notice; two $30\text{-min}$ unannounced spot checks per year.
C17.citations: Tips detect $43\%$ of frauds (web forms $46\%$, email $34\% >$ phone $23\%$); only $24\%$–$27\%$ of SMBs have tip channels; surprise audits cut median loss by $50\%$ (ACFE).

C18.title: Policy Library Hygiene & MSCD 5e Drafting
C18.controls: Active-voice deontic modals (`must`, `may`, `must not`); ban passive voice, `shall` in employee policies, `should`, and $66$ vague adjectives; separate Policy vs. 11-section SOP vs. Record; retire unfollowed paper policies.
C18.citations: Ambiguous/passive policies fail in court or destroy at-will status (*Woolley*) while unfollowed policies prove reckless disregard (*Pioneer Industries*).

C19.title: Outside CPA, Bookkeeper, Tax Preparer & Payroll Custody
C19.controls: "Outsider prepares, Owner approves & releases"; zero bank admin/signing/POA custody for outsiders; verify CPEO certification (IRC § 3511); lock IRS Form 8822-B address & refund routing to taxpayer's own bank account.
C19.citations: $63$ prosecuted CPA/preparer cases ($\$900\text{k}$ median loss: *Jerkins* $\$4.6\text{M}$, *Ginsberg* $\$900\text{k}$); AICPA ET § 1.295 custody independence rule; 31 C.F.R. § 10.31 / IRS OPR 2026-10.

DEF.DEF-01:
6-Account Treasury Partition & UPIC Architecture:
*(1) Receipts Account:* Customer inflows only $\rightarrow$ daily auto-sweep to Operating; full ACH Debit Block; zero paper checks; publish a **UPIC** (Universal Payment Identification Code receive-only number) on invoices.
*(2) Operating Account:* Outsider initiates only; Owner releases; **Payee Positive Pay (`cutoff default = RETURN`)** + **ACH Debit Filter** allowlisting specific 10-character Originator Company IDs with dollar caps.
*(3) Payroll Account:* Zero-balance between runs; funded exact net-pay per run; ACH filter allowing only Payroll Provider Company ID.
*(4) Tax / Trust-Fund Account:* Owner-only; holds withheld 941 payroll tax & state sales tax; ACH filter allowing **only** US Treasury (`EFTPS`) and State DOR debits.
*(5) Reserve Account:* Cash buffer; Owner-only transfers to Operating; zero external wires or ACH debits.
*(6) Company Cards:* Per-card limits + MCC blocks; **never** issue a card to an outside CPA or bookkeeper.
DEF.DEF-02: Bank-Portal Entitlement Matrix ("Outsider Prepares, Owner Releases"): Owner-only Dual Company Administration; CPA/bookkeeper restricted to View + Initiate to existing payees under caps; Owner-only Approve/Release on separate device with out-of-band MFA; Positive Pay cutoff strictly `RETURN`; Remote Deposit Capture (RDC) and Zelle disabled for outsiders.
DEF.DEF-03: IRS & State Tax Authorization & Refund Routing Lock: Form `8821` (view-only) for bookkeepers; scoped Form `2848` POA only for licensed CPA/EA/attorney on specific matters; Form `8655` Reporting Agent remitting via EFTPS under client's EIN; Form `8822-B` locked to Owner's name & physical address; hard 31 C.F.R. § 10.31 & IRS OPR 2026-10 lock mandating tax refunds route solely to an account titled in the taxpayer's name.
DEF.DEF-04: Vendor Master Onboarding & Out-of-Band Callback Lock: Mandatory `C4` out-of-band phone callback to pre-existing number on file; $48.0\text{-hour}$ cooling-off / micro-deposit hold on altered bank routing; Great American Vetting Split (staff performing W-9/TIN/background checks cannot hold ERP permissions to create/edit vendor master records).
DEF.DEF-05: Zero Unit-Price PO Tolerance & Per-Channel Dual-Release Lock: ERP 3-way match unit-price variance tolerance set to $0.0\%$ (small auto-tolerance restricted solely to documented freight); identical dual-signer dollar thresholds enforced across Checks, ACH, Wire, Bill-Pay, and Cards to block channel-switching bypass.
DEF.DEF-06: ERP Primary Admin, Closing-Date Password & Software Change Gate: Owner owns QuickBooks/Xero subscription as Primary Admin; Owner-exclusive Closing-Date Password; non-deletable Audit Log; any accounting/payroll software migration (*Warr*) or custom report-filter edit (*Yarborough-Walker*) treated as a Tier-1 Control Event requiring Owner sign-off.
DEF.DEF-07: Nonprofit, Church & Volunteer Board Governance Shield: Complete ban on rubber signature stamps (*DeCoteau*, *Bringham*); 2-person count + dual-signed deposit slip on cash/offertory (*Boyer*); monthly bank statements with check images routed directly to a non-signing, non-bookkeeping Board Trustee; immediate bank signatory re-verification upon any pastor, executive director, or officer vacancy (*Haigler*).

TW.TW-03: Dormant Canary Vendor Trap (seeded inactive vendor in ERP; any edit, reactivation, or payment initiation fires an instant P1 SMS/email alert to Owner).
TW.TW-04: Seeded $\$108$ Reviewer Error Trap (deliberate non-destructive reconciliation variance seeded to verify whether an outsourced CPA or manager actually inspects support vs. rubber-stamping).
TW.TW-05: Employee-Initials & Levenshtein Lookalike Vendor Trap (flags new vendors matching employee initials, home addresses, payroll routing/account numbers, or Levenshtein edit distance $\le 2$ from major legitimate suppliers, for example, *Power* $\$1.4\text{M}$ / *Ginsberg* "Internal Recovery Systems").
TW.TW-06: Bank-Account Flip Velocity Trap (vendor or employee direct-deposit bank coordinates changed within $14$ days prior to a payout $> \$2,500$ and flipped back).
TW.TW-07: Weekend / After-Hours Manual Journal Entry & Deleted-Check Sequence Gap Detector (*Cormier*).
TW.TW-08: Balance-Sheet Accrual, Suspense & Inventory Expense-Parking Velocity Backstop (catches the *Macy's Form 8-K $\$151\text{M}$* / *Chappell* scheme where cash outflows or personal card charges are parked in balance-sheet accrual/inventory accounts so monthly P&L margins appear normal).
TW.TW-09: Payroll Report-Filter & Software Migration Diff Trap (*Yarborough-Walker* / *Warr*).
TW.TW-10: Nacha R29 $24\text{-Hour}$ Unrecognized ACH Originator Company ID Alert.
TW.TW-11: Tax Refund Routing & IRS Transcript Delta Trap (31 C.F.R. § 10.31 / IRS 3-refund-per-account cap check).
TW.TW-12: Crime/Cyber Insurance Warranty Drift Monitor (alerts if Positive Pay, MFA, or `C4` callback logging drops below 100% policy compliance).
